name: Courtesy Junction
description: Negotiate an unsignalled junction with responsive drivers, then steer into the designated departure road.
natural_language: Drive the yellow delivery car to the striped departure road without touching another car or leaving the road. Other drivers may brake for you; watch whether they actually slow. Full: hold arrow keys to steer and accelerate or brake; release to coast. Simplified: click steering and pedal buttons; their settings persist until changed.

metadata.notes: Original bicycle kinematics, responsive traffic and rectangular contact replay. Provisional L4 baseline; human and agent calibration pending.
